full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: The LLM suggested using three classes with distinct local motifs (sine bump, triangular spike, rectangular pulse) embedded in noisy random-walk backgrounds. I adopted this design with minor modifications to the noise level and motif length.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_modification: I modified the noise standard deviation from 0.3 to 0.5 and adjusted the motif length from 25 to 20 to better match the shapelet length range hyperparameters.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: I visualised sample time series from each class to confirm the motifs are distinct and the noise level is appropriate.
